🔥 ghgrab | Rust
🎯 Primary Use Case: To efficiently browse and download specific files or folders from remote Git repositories without performing a full clone, directly from the command line.
✨ Key Features: • Browse and download files/folders from GitHub, GitLab, Codeberg, Gitea, Forgejo • Terminal User Interface (TUI) for easy navigation and selection • File preview within the TUI
📖 Summary: ghgrab is a command-line interface tool built with Rust that allows users to browse and download specific files or folders from various Git forges like GitHub, GitLab, and others directly from their terminal. It features a user-friendly TUI for easy navigation, file preview, and efficient selection, avoiding the need for full repository clones.
